actions: Isolate the rogue cell via RAN’s IMSI catcher detection rules.
Enforce NAS sequence number validation with a rolling window of 10.
Block NAS messages with unregistered gsm_a_common_elem_id (11) in core.
Enable EEA4 ciphering key validation against known KDF outputs.
Deploy NAS message integrity checks for nested_field1 values >128.
Set NAS message rate limit to 5 requests/minute per UE.
Trigger RRC re-establishment for UEs with NAS-EPS sequence >30.
Deploy 5G NAS replay attack detection with 3-second timestamp checks.
Update core to reject NAS-EPS_EMM_EEA4_SHOW values outside 0-105 range.
Enable 5G NAS authentication failure counters for anomaly scoring.

mapped_mitigations.fgm_name: Cross Check Between Application Layer And Transport Layer
